chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, used to say, when he prayed for rain:
O Allah, give water to Your servants and Your animals, spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land.
He would repeat it three times.

key_terms.أَحْيِ: give life; restore vitality and growth
key_terms.اسْتَسْقَى: he sought rain from Allah through supplication
key_terms.اسْقِ: give water; send rain and provide watering
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct form of invocation and du'a
key_terms.بَهَائِمَكَ: Your animals; livestock and beasts dependent on Allah’s mercy
key_terms.رَحْمَتَكَ: Your mercy; divine compassion manifested in rain and life
key_terms.عِبَادَكَ: Your servants; the human creation in need of Allah’s provision

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say in the prayer for rain?
ai.summary: This hadith preserves a supplication of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم for seeking rain. It shows asking Allah for rain as mercy for people, animals, and the land, and indicates that this du'a was repeated three times.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1500 - Whenever the Messenger of Allah (sw) prayed for rain (Salat al-Istisqa'), he would say:

Allahumma isqi ‘ibadaka wa baha’imaka wa unshur rahmataka wa ahyi biladaka al-maytah
"O’ Allah (swt), provide water to Your servants and Your animals, spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land."
He would repeat this three times.
